title: Trombone novelty pieces and band repertoire
summary: Slim Trombone and sliding trombone pieces, and tunes the band played.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: I wondered in the old days when I was a young kid, I remember some of those pieces like Slim Trombone and there were a whole family of different pieces that the Fillmore published. Do you remember some of those? I think Rastus Trombone, Slim Trombone, different names of some of those pieces. Sally Trombone. Sally Trombone. Did you ever play those pieces?

I played Slim Trombone, I think. I never really had a solid trombone. We played sliding jim and various other things we used to make ourselves, you know, at that time. We'd done more sliding than anything else, you see, because that's what made the hit at that time. We played the side somewhere.
We played a sliding jim. Was that a famous thing there?
We hit an in-muted with Marilyn, Furinella, Liza Jane, Downholm Ray. High Society, Tiger Ray, Clarinet Mamalee.
